svg.text: Discourse AI - Capabilities, Options, and Responsible Rollout Path
Thread Summarization - Moderators get a Summarize button on long threads. No additional setup needed.
Export to .md - manual. No live crawler. Re-upload when docs change.
Native tool (API token needed) OR export .md files and upload
RAG over uploads + Web Browser + Google Search
.txt and .md only - no PDF or DOCX yet
No live crawler - files must be re-uploaded whenever docs change
RAG over uploaded MOSIP knowledge base
Visible to moderators only - human reviews before going public
Start here. Not full automation from day one.
trigger on new post or stalled topic (N days idle)
Rate limit: 60 AI calls/min globally, 2 per post.
Accuracy = KB quality. Gaps in knowledge produce hallucinations.
THE PATH TO FULL VISION - MODERATE ENGINEERING EFFORT
Stays inside Discourse native RAG - no external vector DB
Attach to an AI Persona knowledge base
Deploy in whisper mode - prove it works first
Keep whisper on - build moderator confidence
Catch knowledge gaps before going public
Cron + Discourse API - no manual uploads
Expand to developer and technical queries

text.tspan: Start with whisper mode. Accuracy depends on knowledge base quality. Gaps produce hallucinations. Human review first, automation second.
